title: Verify creating a Fee template (dialog fields and the Create button)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts.
custom_steps:
1. Click 'New Fee / Discount'.
  2. Check the dialog title reads 'New Fee / Discount'.
  3. Set Type to 'Fee'; Calculation Type to '% of Labor Total'; Name 'ZZAUTOTEST Shop Fee'; Percent 5; leave Max Amount blank; leave the Taxable toggle on; optionally add a Description; leave 'Auto-apply to new work orders' off.
  4. Click 'Create'.
custom_expected:
1. The dialog has: Name, Type (Fee or Discount), Calculation Type, '$ Default Amount' (or Percent for a percentage method), 'Max Amount (Optional)' (percentage methods only), a Taxable toggle (on by default), an 'Auto-apply to new work orders' toggle, and a 'Description (Optional)' field.
  2. There is no scope field (every template is whole-work-order).
  3. The confirm button reads 'Create'.
  4. On save a success message appears and the new template appears in the list.
